svg.title: LaplapTech: public ClickHouse to a local Docker analytics stack
svg.desc: Airflow schedules four sequential Docker tasks: Python ingestion, dbt source freshness, dbt build and tests, then Python reconciliation. ClickHouse is the external public source. A local PostgreSQL warehouse contains six raw tables, six Bronze views, thirteen Silver relations and twelve Gold tables. Streamlit reads all twelve Gold models. Airflow metadata uses a separate PostgreSQL database. Named volumes persist state. GitHub Actions tests fixtures in isolation and does not update the active warehouse. Solid green arrows carry data; dashed purple arrows show orchestration or SQL commands.
svg.text: Public source → validated warehouse → interactive dashboard
Pinned stack: Airflow 3.3.2 / Python 3.13 / PostgreSQL 16 / dbt
One local platform · isolated task containers · persistent state
07:00 + 19:00 VN · catchup off · one active run · RAM pool: 4 slots
Scheduler creates containers through Docker Engine
NAMED VOLUMES warehouse · metadata · config · logs · artifacts
No ETL to the active warehouse
Docker off → local scheduling stops. Data persists on volumes. Gold is validated per run; publication is not atomic across all models.
